more_info.banned_in:
Banned in: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
Directive 2006/52/EC withdrew the EU food-additive permission; Member States had to prohibit non-compliant trade and use by 15 August 2008, with an exception for previously marketed or labelled stocks.
California's enacted food-product prohibition is scheduled to apply from 1 January 2027; it is not a current California prohibition on the 2026 check date.
West Virginia's statewide provision has a statutory date of 1 January 2028; a federal court enjoined health-department enforcement in December 2025.
more_info.overview: Propylparaben is the propyl ester of para-hydroxybenzoic acid, a chemically defined member of the paraben preservative family. Its preservative function is to limit microbial spoilage during storage. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
